title: Admissions for 2027-2028 (Master's and Doctoral Programs)
field: Social sciences, humanities, public administration and economics
about: The Doha Institute for Graduate Studies accepts applications for its master's and doctoral programmes for the 2027-2028 academic year from 1 September 2026 until 15 January 2027 through its admissions portal.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Admissions for 2027-2028 (Master's and Doctoral Programs) at the Doha Institute for Graduate Studies in Doha, Qatar, application deadline 15 January 2027. The photo shows the arch-shaped Katara Towers at dusk in Lusail, north of Doha.
